specs.title: SCN-011: Staff can list enquiries with a valid token

steps.title: Given I am authenticated as staff
When I GET /api/message with the token cookie
Then the response status is 200
And every message has id, name, subject and read

specs.title: SCN-012: Valid staff credentials return a token

steps.title: When I POST the staff credentials to /api/auth/login
Then the response status is 200
And the body contains a non-empty "token"

specs.title: SCN-013: Invalid staff credentials are refused

steps.title: When I POST the staff username with a wrong password to /api/auth/login
Then the response status is 401
And the body is {"error": "Invalid credentials"}

specs.title: SCN-014: An enquiry sent from the UI is readable by staff through the API

steps.title: Given I am on the home page
When I submit the contact form with a unique name and a unique subject
And I see the confirmation
Then the authenticated message list contains an enquiry with that name and subject

specs.title: SCN-015: The rooms list follows the Room schema

steps.title: When I GET /api/room
Then the response status is 200
And every room matches the Room schema

specs.title: SCN-016: An existing room can be fetched by id

steps.title: Given I know the id of a room from GET /api/room
When I GET /api/room/{id}
Then the response status is 200
And the body is that room and matches the Room schema
